name: Elmadam
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Elmadam is a person mentioned only in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in Luke. He is listed as the son of Er and the father of Kosam in the genealogical line leading from David through Nathan to Jesus. Very little is known about him beyond his place in Jesus' lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Elmadam is listed in the Gospel of Luke as part of Jesus' family tree, placed between Er and Kosam.

keyEvents.title: Part of Nathan's line
keyEvents.description: Elmadam belongs to that branch of David's descendants that goes through Nathan, unlike Matthew's genealogy which follows the line of Solomon.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the lineage of David
keyEvents.description: Through Elmadam and his ancestors, Jesus' belonging to David's royal lineage is confirmed, as prophesied in the Old Testament.

keyEvents.title: The Promise of the Messiah through David's Line
keyEvents.description: Elmadam is part of the fulfillment of God's promise that the Messiah would come from David's line, as prophesied by Isaiah.
